GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence and over-racing, hooked 3 Wide entering back turn and racing ungenerously, worked up to Two Wide joint Lead at 900m, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # raced ungenerously
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced early, shifted wider and then permitted to stride to the lead passing the 900m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat back 3-4l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, took over 100m and drew clear # all honours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly between the 1400m and 1000m. Approaching the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until shortly after straightening. Near the 200m was directed in around heels to continue to improve.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Straight To The Front Settled Down 2 Lengths Clear own terms, led 4 Lengths Turning for home Collared x 100m Couldn'T Go On - # gave good sight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount over raced in the early and middle stages, and this had a detrimental effect on gelding’s finishing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, held position in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages. GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages. Rdr reported gelding wasn’t suited to tight turning track. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok going forward Soon After settled down Two Wide second 1 Lengths (1200m), same 600 before closing the gap approaching Turn , Straightened Up Quickly taking over & went for home! 2 Lengths Clear 100 only to be # nailed on the line
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 1000m, off heels before the corner and he joined Leader and looked chance Straightening Up , Just could not match her last 200m but he held Clear second spot # brave chase
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to over race leaving the 1300m until near the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 600m and trailed 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Made Good Ground in Straight # arrived too late

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Held up for clear running round home turn until the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th then 3rd Inside 2 Lengths held-up Turning for home had Nowhere To Go Until 300m, then Just Kept Going One Pace and # Just Held Ground
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # never a real threat
